title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics improvements and slo-toolkit helpers
author: Arianna Chen
release_notes: Enhance incident-bot on-call autodiagnostics: runbook autolinking heuristics, SLO hint enrichment, and new on-call helper endpoints. Backwards-compatible; no config migration required.
description: Context: on-call teams have been asking for higher-precision autodiagnostics and easier runbook discovery in noisy SLO incidents. This PR improves the incident-bot's autodiagnostics pipeline and adds small helpers in the slo-toolkit to provide richer hints to on-call responders. Motivation: reduce mean time to triage (MTTT) by surfacing the most relevant runbooks and SLO context earlier in the on-call flow. What changed: 1) Runbook autolinking heuristics: added a combined scoring function that weighs recent alert fingerprints + SLO tags + last-10-min traces; tuned thresholds to reduce false-positives. 2) SLO hint enrichment: new endpoint in slo-toolkit that returns top-3 SLOs affecting a service plus short suggested runbook snippets. 3) On-call helper endpoints: small REST endpoints to fetch pre-ranked runbooks, related incidents, and suggested remediation steps. 4) Telemetry: added metrics incident_bot.autodiag.match_score and slo_toolkit.hints_latency_ms and tracing spans for the autodiag path. 5) Tests: unit tests for heuristics, integration test that exercises autolink flow against the synthetic incident fixture. Implementation details: - Introduces AutodiagScorer with configurable weights; default weights tuned from historical incidents. - Caching: short-lived (30s) cache for score results to avoid thundering during alert storms. - Safety: any autolinked runbook is returned as a suggestion only; users must explicitly acknowledge. Rollout plan: rollout behind feature flag incident_bot.autodiag_enabled; staged rollout to 10% of incidents for 24h, monitor match precision and oncall feedback. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added - [x] Metrics and traces added - [x] Feature flag gating - [x] Docs updated in incident-bot runbooks.md Testing: CI (unit/integration/lint) passed; load test run locally with 1000 concurrent alerts to validate caching and latency. Observability: added dashboards (SLO toolkit -> Autodiag) and alert: Autodiag:MatchPrecision drop < 0.7. Backwards compatibility: no breaking API changes. Documentation: updated runbooks.md and slo-toolkit README with examples.

notes_for_release: Adds opt-in autodiagnostics and slo-toolkit helpers behind feature flag incident_bot.autodiag_enabled; rollout gradual. Operators should monitor Autodiag:MatchPrecision and slo_toolkit.hints_latency_ms.
rollback_plan: Feature flag can be toggled off; delete cache keys if rollback required. If precision regressions observed, disable autodiag and revert scorer weights via config.
impact: Low risk: suggestion-only changes surfaced to on-call. Telemetry added for monitoring. No DB schema changes.
qa_notes: To exercise locally: run `make dev` and POST the synthetic incident to /api/v1/incidents?autodiag=true. Use AUTODIAG_CACHE_TTL_SEC=1 for fast iteration.
